title: The Sunken Lane's 'read the lane for where he walks (wits)' check is offered on first arrival with zero framing — no NPC or journal entry has yet explained it matters. I failed it twice (rolls under DC) with no idea why I was rolling. Only much later, at Fulk's cask-yard, did dialogue retroactively reveal it was the first step of The Victualler's Errand.
where: The Sunken Lane (Mootcombe, on the descent from the Cairn-Track) / 'read the lane for where he walks'
